Measurement rules out a Grok origin (no same-day Grok dispatch on any of these units in any window) but does not rule out an owner origin, and 48277e7's own commit body calls the sequence-D ruling an 'owner correction ruling'. The supportable finding is that no adjudication of e4968e, fa4a72 or eb9a02 is evidenced in the record and the only artifacts claiming to be rulings are unrecoverable -- still a P1-severity custody failure under docs/wire.md absence discipline, but a different claim from the one written. findings.claim: Wrong predicate named. There is no job=adjudicate in this lane's practice. ops/devlane/task/jobs.json defines an 'adjudicate' template, but the one record the audit nominates as the pattern, 20260906T023832Z-adjudicate-grok-8cdf11, carries job='adversarial-review' and stage='adjudicate'. The 'adjudicate' token in a record filename is the stage. The audit's listdir/grep filter therefore tests the right axis while its prose names the wrong one; a reader who applied the stated predicate to .result.envelope.job would find zero adjudicate jobs in the entire corpus and draw a false conclusion. Does not change any verdict.

The stage scan is necessary but not sufficient to establish absent third-harness adjudication, and the audit offers no other measurement. This lane records rulings that were never dispatched: .dev/ladder-inputs/ retains twelve *-ruling.md files, including conduct-task-test-ruling.md which 20260906T105326Z-tests-grok-d27ce8 was scoped against, and no adjudicate-stage record exists for any of them after 20260906T023832Z. cross-review.md:212-213 also names 'the session' as a permitted adjudicator for two of three rows. What actually forecloses a dispatched third-harness ruling for A-D is reading unit and brief.scope on every same-day Grok record -- four records on four different units (conduct-task-outputs, conduct-onboard-independent, conduct-task-semantics), none adjudicative, and 123029Z-review-grok-3cfa27 launched at 12:30:30Z, not before 18ec12. That is two jq invocations the audit did not run.

envelope.note:
Third-harness ruling on the Grok custody audit at in/ag-conduct-document-custody-audit.json. Overall PARTIAL. Full ruling at out/RULING.md.

Per finding: P1 sequence A (e076d5 CHANGES at 8d5d256 -> 20b3d6/8fd333e) UPHELD, and upheld beyond the audit's own argument — 20b3d6 carries no ruling input of any kind, its scope closes "The conductor accepts these bounded corrections; no new planning or permission request is needed," and 8fd333e's trailers name Finder Claude Opus 5 and Fixer GPT-6 with no adjudicator. That is cross-review.md:223-224 exactly. P1 sequences B, C, D PARTIAL: the custody-evidence gap holds at P1 severity, but "producer self-adjudication" and "is not Grok" are asserted, not shown — the three ruling blobs are unrecoverable and 48277e7's own body calls D's ruling an "owner correction ruling," which would be the backstop rather than a harness gap. P2 (four blobs unrecoverable) UPHELD; its absence discipline is the strongest part of the report, declaring "looked and found nothing" for the snapshot and "could not look" for the live trees. P3 (later APPROVE is not sequencing compliance) UPHELD: 0e4580 reads b0dfb69, aa0cb7 reads 48277e7, 02a617 reads 3f84832 — each a later SHA than the CHANGES it is offered against, each stage=review not adjudicate, each given the fix record and ruling blob alongside the original, none given the reviewed SHA plus the report and nothing else as jobs.json .adjudicate prescribes.

On the brief's first question: absence of a named adjudicate job does NOT by itself establish absent third-harness adjudication. Three grounds. The predicate is misnamed — the filename token is the stage, not the job; the audit's own pattern record 20260906T023832Z-adjudicate-grok-8cdf11 is job=adversarial-review, stage=adjudicate. The scan is under-powered — this lane records in-session rulings that leave no dispatch at all (twelve *-ruling.md files retained in .dev/ladder-inputs/, none with a matching adjudicate-stage record after 02:38), and cross-review.md:212-213 permits "the session" for two of three rows. What does carry the conclusion is a measurement the audit did not run: every same-day Grok record read whole shows four dispatches on four different units with no adjudicative scope, so no dispatched third-harness ruling exists in any of the four windows. That still does not exclude an owner ruling.

Missing snapshot evidence distinguished from canonical absence: the four ruling blobs are absent from this snapshot (measured three ways) but were live at dispatch time with recorded sha256 and byte counts, and their canonical location is the original jobs' in/ directories, which this job could not look at and did not. Non-retention is nonetheless a departure from the lane's own habit, since twelve comparable rulings are retained.

Bounded prospective repair, six steps: recover-or-declare the four blobs as evidence; four cold stage=adjudicate Grok runs, each on the original reviewed SHA with its own original report and nothing else (8d5d256+e076d5, 8fd333e+e4968e, f15ca22+fa4a72, 51ff07e+eb9a02); act only after; name the gap in the PR body. Grok is eligible — it produced neither the documentary artifacts nor the documentary findings, and this custody audit rules on none of them. No amend, squash, revert, relabel or waiver; dce07d's invalid envelope, 3ee48f0, c35ed64 and .dev/ladder-inputs/conduct-unit1a-20260906/ stay as they are; no past sequence is claimed compliant.

Adjudicator custody declared: I am Claude Opus 5 and Claude is the finder harness in all four audited sequences. I am a third harness for the artifact under ruling here (Grok-produced audit of Codex-produced records) and eligible on it; I am not independent of the underlying documentary findings, which is why none of the 24 is touched. This ruling is not itself the adjudication steps 1-4 prescribe, does not certify the tree, approves nothing, and does not self-approve its own six findings. No runtime, suite, full floor or live-state call was made; snapshot left clean (git status --porcelain empty).
